import os
from cyhole.helius import Client

api_key = os.getenv("HELIUS_API_KEY")
if not api_key:
    raise ValueError("HELIUS_API_KEY environment variable not set")

client = Client(api_key=api_key)

wallet_address = "YOUR_WALLET_ADDRESS"

assets = client.get_assets_by_owner(owner_address=wallet_address)

print(f"Digital Asset Standard assets for {wallet_address}:")
for asset in assets.get("items", []):
    print(f"  - ID: {asset.get('id')}")
    print(f"    Name: {asset.get('content', {}).get('metadata', {}).get('name')}")
    print(f"    Symbol: {asset.get('content', {}).get('metadata', {}).get('symbol')}")
